entities.summary: Alicia Garcia Herrero is a Spanish economist and academic based in Hong Kong. She has been the chief economist for Asia-Pacific at French investment bank Natixis and adjunct Professor at Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) since June 2015. She is also an adjunct professor at Sunyatsen University and has recently joined insurance company AGEAS as an independent board member. Alicia Garcia Herrero was a performers & entertainers from Spain (b. 1968). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
